scope: Route self-contained public web research from ordinary signed-in Workspace chat to official DeepSeek Search, preserve publisher constraints in mixed research and presentation requests, and render a plain status for stale public approval replies.

keep: Keep the same authenticated public-read broker, private evidence store, source URLs and canonical billing ledger.
extend: Respect an explicit public Search request from the typed turn when a chat-only plan omitted it.
Admit unfamiliar self-contained topics from the explicit command after current-turn privacy and destination checks.
Keep named public publishers and retrieval terms when the user also requests a chart, table, timeline or checklist.
Render historical automatic Search review replies as a plain explanation in Workspace, Copy and shared answers. Existing private research and connected-action reviews retain their controls.
Keep the separate approval boundary for consequential actions and validate source provenance before synthesis.

schemaImpact.rollout: Use the existing Workspace chat and source response shape.
schemaImpact.rollback: Restore the verified compatible frontend, API and Job pair.

auth.description: Use the existing verified Workspace actor.

tenant.description: Public retrieval never takes private history, attachments or project data as query input.

approval.description: Direct public reads use the existing automatic path. Private export and consequential operations keep their authorization checks.

credentials.description: Use the existing server-owned official Search credential and canonical model credential.

egress.description: Admit additional explicit current-turn public topic forms through the existing single-use, audited public-read boundary.

cost.description: Newly eligible explicit lookups reserve and settle the existing single official Search request and answer generation.

billing.description: Keep the existing canonical charging and settlement rules.

tests.scope: Verify an unfamiliar explicit public lookup with a stale chat-only plan, no approval creation, one search, one synthesis, verified links, and private and ambiguous inputs withheld.
Verify connected-app operation and mixed task guards and the existing audited network and budget admission.
Verify the legacy public reply cannot display a confirmation or price in a new or reopened signed-in conversation. This uses controlled provider responses.

architecture.reason: Use the existing Workspace planner, chat pipeline, official Search broker and answer presentation.

rollout: Verify exact-source CI, authenticated staging with fresh official Search and DeepSeek receipts, and the protected production release.
rollback: Restore the existing decoder-compatible frontend, API and Job through the reviewed operator.
knownGaps: Ambiguous, context-dependent or sensitive target requests require a self-contained public topic for automatic retrieval.
Fresh provider acceptance and protected publication have separate evidence requirements.

blockers: Fresh exact-source staging and the protected production release are required.
